subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept the exact MXC native dependency graph and the preview SDK's argv-carried base64 configuration envelope for this official sandbox plugin?
rationale: The envelope can contain sandbox environment and filesystem-policy data, while the package ships native executors and an install-script dependency; accepting that host-observable boundary requires repository security intent.

options.title: Accept with preview caveat
options.body: Approve the exact resolved graph and document that host process arguments may expose the encoded sandbox configuration until upstream replaces the transport.

options.title: Wait for non-argv transport
options.body: Pause landing until Microsoft MXC provides a non-argv configuration channel, then refresh dependency and native Windows proof.

recommendation.title: Accept with preview caveat
recommendation.body: Approve the exact resolved graph and document that host process arguments may expose the encoded sandbox configuration until upstream replaces the transport.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns much of the relevant sandbox and fs-safe history, is assigned to the PR, and is listed by Dependency Guard as an authorized security approver.
